results.claim: For the bounded race94 COBRA texture-index-0 lifetime, the decoded stream contains 106 geometry tags and 5,915 packed RGBAQ records; the observed register payload is per-vertex data and does not by itself establish how the game computes its color values.

The saved overlay-5 assembly uses FCAND tests with masks 0x28a28a and 0x145145 after CLIPW operations and has branches that skip the nearby packet-store/XGKICK block; this does not prove that these branches explain the observed ADC mismatch pattern.
The saved overlay-6 assembly stores vf12, vf30, and vf16 before XGKICK; those register names and stores do not alone identify the output lanes as STQ, color, and position.

The parent source-geometry audit reports 11,196 positive, 4 negative, and 4,857 source-suppressed COBRA triangles for source file hash 751fb754d2510c9d5d7fce725c13f5bed5e9e2edc0d670644dbb688d488e6912, while explicitly declining to prove the packed signed8 XYZ values are final shading normals.

handling: Advisory evidence check only. Deterministic dump decode, pinned source, source hashes, and parent audit control the reported facts.
